item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:15 AM 31 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Corcuera, Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Romblon and Banton) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Mansalay, Bulalacao and Roxas) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
